record.paper_title: Multiplier sequences, classes of generalized Bessel functions and open problems
record.original_question: Let beta_k=e^{sqrt(k)}/k! for k>=0, and for each n>=0 let the nth Jensen polynomial associated with {beta_k} be g_n(x)=sum_{k=0}^n binom(n,k) beta_k x^k. The source reports that g_n has only real zeros for every 1<=n<=30. Does g_n have only real zeros for every n>=1?

evidence.quote: Definition 7. Let T = {gamma_k}_0^infinity be a sequence of real numbers. For n in N_0, we define the nth Jensen polynomial associated with the sequence T to be g_n(x) := T[(1+x)^n] = sum_{k=0}^n binom(n,k) gamma_k x^k.

Let beta_k := e^{sqrt(k)}/k! for k = 0, 1, 2, .... On the other hand, our numerical work shows that the Jensen polynomials of degree n (1 <= n <= 30), associated with the sequence {beta_k}_0^infinity, have only real zeros.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Define the sequence $\{\beta_k\}_{k\geq 0}$ by
$$\beta_k = \frac{e^{\sqrt{k}}}{k!}, \qquad k = 0, 1, 2, \dots.$$
For each integer $n \geq 0$, define the $n$th Jensen polynomial associated with $\{\beta_k\}$ by
$$g_n(x) = \sum_{k=0}^{n} \binom{n}{k}\, \beta_k\, x^k.$$
Prove or disprove: for every integer $n \geq 1$, the polynomial $g_n(x)$ has only real zeros.
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search for this specific Jensen polynomial hyperbolicity question (with coefficients e^{sqrt(k)}/k!) returns only general background on Jensen polynomials and multiplier sequences, with no source establishing real-rootedness for all n. The known evidence is numerical (small n), and no proof or counterexample appears in the literature, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The Fox–Wright functions and Laguerre multiplier sequences
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Jensen polynomials, Laguerre–Pólya class membership, and related open questions about multiplier sequences arising from generalized Bessel functions.
status_evidence.claim: No proof is recorded that the Jensen polynomials of {e^{sqrt(k)}/k!} are hyperbolic for all n; the question is left as an open numerical observation.

status_evidence.title: Jensen polynomials for the Riemann zeta function and other sequences
status_evidence.snippet: General framework relating hyperbolicity of Jensen polynomials to real-rootedness properties of associated sequences.
status_evidence.claim: Provides general theory but does not address the specific sequence beta_k = e^{sqrt(k)}/k!.
